description.value: Established in 2006 in Oliver, BC, Savvios Family Restaurant sits in the heart of the Okanagan Valley wine country, serving Greek specialties, Italian dishes, steaks, and seafood alongside an extensive local wine list. The restaurant offers both indoor dining and patio seating, with regular lamb and pig BBQ events and live entertainment on the patio. Touring cyclists riding through wine country will find a full sit-down meal, takeout options, and walk-ins welcome.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and confirms an active restaurant in Oliver, BC since 2006, with Greek and Italian cuisine. Takeout is explicitly advertised ('Take out available: Call 250-498-4418 to place your order!'), and the menu uses '(V)' and '(GF)' markers indicating vegetarian and gluten-free options. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; website lists 250-498-4418 — phone added from website.
